recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: An extreme close-up ground-level shot capturing anonymous bare human feet and lower legs stepping gracefully and deliberately over ancient moss-covered river stones in a shallow crystal-clear stream. The scene is set within a meticulously designed and CGI-enhanced natural garden corridor — not a wild forest, but a curated high-end residential landscape where nature feels perfected and immaculate. One bare foot is mid-step, raised slightly and placing down gently on a smooth dark-green mossy rock, while the other foot rests on an adjacent pale grey stone half-submerged in water. The water flows softly between and around the stones, catching warm amber-gold reflections of afternoon sunlight filtering through overhead foliage. Ground-level lush ferns and small leafy plants fill the immediate foreground edges of the frame in vivid detail. The camera angle is extremely low — nearly flush with the water surface — creating a dramatic, intimate perspective that emphasizes the sensory connection between the human body and nature. The film language is immersive and experiential rather than observational: the viewer is brought into direct sensory contact with the environment. Depth of field is extremely shallow: the feet and nearest stone are rendered in tack-sharp clarity, while everything behind quickly dissolves into a warm luminous bokeh of soft greens, amber light patches, and blurred vegetation. The bokeh quality is smooth and cinematic, typical of large-aperture prime lens photography. Lighting is warm golden-hour dappled sunlight streaming from the upper right, creating gentle highlight pools on the skin and wet stone surfaces and catching the micro-textures of moss, lichen, and stone grain. The light feels organic and serendipitous despite being carefully designed. Color palette: warm amber-gold (#D4A85C) for highlights, mossy deep green (#5C7A3E) for vegetation, earth brown-grey (#8B7355) for stone texture, soft pale sage (#B8C9A3) for background foliage, near-black shadow anchor (#3D2B1A). The tonal world is unified by warm amber grading applied throughout, preventing any color from reading as cold or clinical. The overall mood is serene, sensory, aspirational leisure — evoking the feeling of a private luxury garden retreat integrated seamlessly into a premium apartment complex. Every visual element reinforces this: the flawless moss texture, the crystalline water, the perfect golden light. Post-processing signature: warm amber color grade with luminous soft-glow halos around lit areas, CGI-enhanced photoreal texture on vegetation and water that enhances beyond realistic photography without appearing artificial. Cinematic 2.39:1 letterbox format with black bars at top and bottom of a 1920x1080 container. Korean residential premium presale advertisement aesthetic — understated sensory luxury. No text or graphic overlays in the scene itself; no identifiable faces, no brand marks visible. The shot establishes the sensory register for the entire advertisement — before any verbal proposition, the viewer is transported into a world of curated natural beauty and tactile richness that signals the quality of the lifestyle on offer. This is the grammar of aspirational property advertising in South Korea: lead with feeling, not with facts. The image speaks of a life in which nature is always close, always pristine, and always accessible on one's own terms within the boundaries of a community designed to deliver exactly this.

The scene is a curated architectural nature experience — a fusion of lush tropical-inspired landscaping and premium Korean apartment complex design. The garden features oversized smooth stone stepping pads positioned across shallow clear water, large leafy tropical plants including monstera-type and bird-of-paradise varieties, and patches of ground cover moss and spreading ferns that create a rich layered foreground. A broad contemporary wooden architectural canopy or overhang structure frames the upper portion of the left side of the frame, creating architectural depth and suggesting a covered walkway or transition zone between outdoor garden and building interior. Warm dark wood slats make up the canopy, contrasting organically with the surrounding greenery. In the background, tall beige-cream CGI-rendered residential apartment towers rise against a luminous golden-orange sky. These towers are photorealistic in quality — clean facades with rhythmic window grids — yet clearly part of an aspirational render rather than raw construction photography. A strong golden sun positioned behind and to the right of the subject creates a powerful backlit effect — the female figure is partially silhouetted with a brilliant warm rim glow emanating around the edge of her white dress, creating a cinematic halo that separates her luminously from the mid-ground. Sun rays and a subtle lens flare streak across the upper frame from the sun's position. The left side of the frame hosts white Korean text copy overlay in two stacked lines. The composition uses the full available width of the 2.39:1 frame, with the subject positioned off-center to the right in a classic thirds placement that balances the architectural copy element on the left. Lighting quality: strong hard golden-hour backlight at approximately 4 to 5:1 key-to-fill ratio, warm 2800K sun temperature with amber-orange color quality, long directional shadows extending toward camera across the stone and water surface. Color palette: dominant warm golden amber (#D4A96A) in the light quality and sky, rich garden green (#4A7C3F) in the vegetation, warm white dress (#E8DFC8) picking up the golden light, medium sage green (#8FA878) in the mid-ground foliage, and earthy stone accent (#C4A66B) in the stepping pads. The overall atmosphere is aspirational and premium — a South Korean residential presale advertisement showing idealized daily lifestyle within an apartment complex where nature has been perfected and seamlessly integrated into architecture. Post-processing signature: rich warm amber grade throughout, luminous glow treatment applied to backlit edges, CGI photoreal integration of towers with live-action garden and figure. Cinematic 2.39:1 letterbox format with horizontal black bars at top and bottom. No identifiable faces; generic lifestyle model silhouetted and haloed by backlight removes identity. The natural and built environments are presented as seamlessly unified rather than in tension — this is the core lifestyle proposition of the development: that urban apartment living and genuine immersion in nature are not mutually exclusive but are in fact the defining combination of this specific offering. The CGI towers serve as a reminder that this paradise is within a residential complex, not a remote retreat.
